Hi Katie — welcome!

Thanks for the SOC2 summary. A couple quick items to accelerate the procurement path:

1) DPA: We can accept an executed PDF via DocuSign. I'll share the standard Redwood DPA link below — if Novus prefers to send your DPA we can review, but e-sign is fastest.
2) SOC 2: the redacted summary is fine for now. For procurement/security acceptance we also need a short subprocessor inventory (CSV or doc) and the SOC 2 attestation/report link (or Doc ID).
3) PO details: please confirm legal name (exact), tax ID (W-9), remittance address; we'll issue a PO once procurement has those. Standard terms: net 30 unless otherwise negotiated.

Laura (cc) from Procurement will pick up the PO issuance. Ben (cc) from Legal may spot-check the DPA if needed.

Useful links:
- Redwood SOC2 summary (internal): https://s3.redwood-infra.com/soc2/2026/redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf
- DocuSign for Redwood DPA: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-novus-dpa

If you can attach the subprocessor list and the signed DPA by end of day Thu Oct 8, procurement should be able to cut a PO by Fri Oct 9.

—Rishi

Hi Katie — looping in Procurement.

Thanks for the note — to get Novus into our PO system we need the following items completed and returned:

1) Completed Vendor Intake Form (attached). Please fill the remittance address, legal entity name exactly as it appears on your tax docs, and provide your EIN/TIN.
2) W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax docs for non-US.
3) Subprocessor list (CSV preferred) and the SOC 2 download link or Doc ID (we received the summary but need the attestation reference).
4) Banking details only if you require ACH, otherwise we will invoice via email for payment on net 30.

Attachments: Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf

Procurement turnaround: once we have the completed intake + DPA, we typically issue a PO within 2 business days. Please send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai and cc your billing contact on the PO so payments route correctly.

If there are any contract redlines to the DPA, please flag them now so Legal (Ben) can triage — minor edits are usually OK but anything material will require additional review.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
